page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highmem-2 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the c4n family. It features 2 dedicated virtual CPUs paired with 15.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 7.5 GB per vCPU. This configuration does not include local storage or bundled GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage options for persistent disk requirements.

Operating with dedicated CPU allocation, the instance ensures consistent compute performance without the resource contention typical of shared-core environments. The high memory density relative to the low vCPU count makes this instance a cost-efficient option for workloads requiring a larger memory footprint without the need to pay for additional, unused compute cores.

The c4n-highmem-2 is designed for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high parallel processing power or local storage. Suitable applications include small-scale databases, caching layers, memory-bound enterprise applications, and lightweight data processing tasks.
